code: deadline per band (Nth business day after now, calendar from the policy)
promise date validity (past / after deadline / non-business day)
vague period: ask 1 time(s), then the deadline
amount: full first, floor offer after 'too much' or a below-floor amount, accept floor..full
read-back of the whole package, confirmation bound to that package, writes only from the confirmed package
hardship: one code-owned sympathy+support offer, no persuasion afterwards, customer's own date/amount kept
notes per product (not used by this brief), none after a transfer; close outcome from recorded/transfer/product results
goodbye -> notes -> exactly one close_call in the negotiation path

identity: question order, combining an answer given in parts, format check (date, digits), one bank call per complete answer, each bank result processed once, hint / unreadable / service error never counted as wrong, next question only after the bank verified the current one, account only after the bank's full verification, failed only on the bank's result (no tries left), declines counted (2 close), a person asked for: help offered 1 time(s), then an engine-run transfer; every sentence and the close of the stage
support offer answered (accept -> engine-run transfer, decline -> hardship close or the customer's own offer) routed by extraction, no model speech in that turn
a message that stops mid-sentence: ask to go on (at most 2 per call)
model: turning the customer's words into events (identity: answer parts, corrections, refusals, questions; negotiation: payment events, dates into YYYY-MM-DD from the calendar table)
opening confirmation and its re-ask count
third party, callback window validity and re-ask
transfer decision in the negotiation stage (restructuring, a person; close mapping is code)
questions outside payment in the negotiation stage (free answer, no digits or questions allowed in it)
unsupported_by_code: Interpret 'next <weekday>' as that weekday in the following calendar week and 'this <weekday>' as the one in the current week, both relative to now. Convert the result into an exact date before the code check.
